steps.name: brew strong tea
steps.note: The tea is boiled or steeped until nearly black, then strained.

steps.name: churn with tea
steps.note: The brew is churned in a wooden churn, or shaken, until it is as thick as stew or thick oil.

sources.text: The brewing of strong tea, the butter and salt, and the churning, from its article; it gives no amounts.
